definitions.explanation: The chemical solution used to develop exposed photographic film or paper, turning the latent image into a visible one.

examples.japanese: {現像液|げんぞうえき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{浸|ひた}す→浸す：07506_hitasu⟧。
⟦フィルム→フィルム：02951_firumu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{現像液|げんぞうえき}につける。
examples.english: put the film into the developer

examples.japanese: ⟦{暗室|あんしつ}→暗室：15514_anshitsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{現像液|げんぞうえき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{温度|おんど}→温度：00333_ondo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{慎重|しんちょう}→慎重：03264_shinchou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{管理|かんり}する→管理する：21910_kanrisuru⟧。
examples.english: carefully control the temperature of the developer in the darkroom

notes:
Composed of ⟦{現像|げんぞう}→現像：06362_genzou⟧ (photo developing) + ⟦{液|えき}→液：02270_eki⟧ (liquid).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {現像液|げんぞうえき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{浸|ひた}す→浸す：07506_hitasu⟧: to immerse in developer
- {現像液|げんぞうえき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{温度|おんど}→温度：00333_ondo⟧: developer temperature

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {定着液|ていちゃくえき}: fixer — the solution used after the developer to stabilize the image
- ⟦{現像|げんぞう}→現像：06362_genzou⟧: developing — the process itself, not the chemical
